name: std::basic_string_view<CharT,Traits>::front
intro: Returns reference to the first character in the view. The behavior is undefined if empty() == true.

sections.title: Return value
sections.text: Reference to the first character, equivalent to operator[](0).

examples.output:
A ABCDEF
B BCDEF
C CDEF
D DEF
E EF
F F
